component.name: MousePods
component.summary: AirPods as a head tracker for Steam/Proton games

description.p: Reads the motion sensors of AirPods over Bluetooth and moves the in-game camera of TrackIR/FreeTrack games running through Proton, without opentrack. Per-game smoothing, ranges and a neck model. Fork of MousePods by Matteo Gaudioso.
